title: Locally involutive semigroups
summary: We introduce locally involutive semigroups and embed them into the category of ordered groupoids. This embedding restricts to a correspondence between quasi-involutive semigroups and ordered groupoids with mediator, extending the classical ESN-correspondence between inverse semigroups and inductive groupoids. An important subcategory of locally involutive semigroups is formed by left involutive semigroups because the classifying topos of an inverse semigroup S is equivalent to the category of left involutive semigroups étale over S [4].
